observations.transport_rocket: Capsule nose, framed hatch, wide landing stance and visible engine bells read in both sizes; native checks confirm four landing pads and three truly empty bell mouths.
observations.hangar: Low broad arch and large empty spacecraft portal remain readable in both sizes, with interior floor markings, rear service lockers and attached roof equipment.
observations.exploration_rover: Rounded pressurized cabin, three visible near-side wheels with six actual wheel positions, sensor head and open sample tray read at both resolutions.
observations.fuel_tank: Two capsule-ended vessels, overhead manifold, front transfer plumbing, two valve controls and shared skid remain distinct in both sizes.
observations.control_tower: Stout shaft, broad flared window cabin and rounded roof/antennae read in the final pair. Lowering the cabin floor/platform eight large cells corrected the initially obscured window band.
